=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- prompts/review-consolidator.txt:54 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The prompt instruction at line 54 uses uppercase `PRIOR_DECISION` — "If `PRIOR_DECISION` is `accepted-residual` or `won't-fix`, do not re-emit the finding..." but line 53 documents the data field as lowercase `prior_decision=`, and `scripts/review_consolidate.sh` line 150 generates the actual data as `prior_decision=...` (lowercase).
  WHY: The instruction and data field names do not match; the consolidator LLM will look for the token `PRIOR_DECISION` in the `=== BEGIN PRIOR ROUND DECISIONS ===` block, find only `prior_decision=`, and conclude no entries carry a prior decision, defeating the entire re-review suppression feature.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Extend scripts/review_consolidate.sh and prompts/review-consolidator.txt so prior ledger decisions are passed into the consolidator, accepted-residual / won't-fix items are not re-emitted unless evidence worsens, and RE_REVIEW_SKIP is logged when a prior decision suppresses a repeat finding."
  Expected change site: prompts/review-consolidator.txt line 54 (the PRIOR_DECISION reference that does not match the data field name)
  Evidence of absence: The prompt at line 54 uses uppercase `PRIOR_DECISION` but `scripts/review_consolidate.sh` line 150 emits the data as `prior_decision=` (lowercase). No hunk in this PR aligns these two spellings. The acceptance criterion "Prior accepted-residual decisions suppress repeat findings unless the evidence worsens" depends entirely on the LLM correctly matching the instruction name to the data field name; with the current mismatch the feature will not work.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Add the phase-F and phase-J fixtures plus one focused regression test that covers residual suppression, worsened-diff re-emission, review-state mapping, and break-glass bypass."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml, .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Evidence of absence: The test file `tests/test_review_rereview_and_approval_rubric.py` exists in the PR diff (305 lines, 5 test functions) but `grep -rn 'test_review_rereview' .github/workflows/` returns zero matches across all three CI workflow files. Every other `tests/test_review_*.py` file has a corresponding entry in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; this one does not. The 5 test functions and their 6 fixture files will never execute in CI. A future change that breaks the re-review suppression or approval rubric wiring will go undetected until a production incident.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
